candidate_enumeration.audit_record_cap_note: Gate 1B engine audit stores at most 512 records; the 512 captured records, not records_seen, define this frame.

rule: After candidate installation kinds are enumerated, if at least two PHYSICAL_REPLACEMENT candidates exist, choose the two smallest subgraph_index values among them.
Otherwise choose the smallest subgraph_index NO_OP_FULL_CORRESPONDENCE candidate and the smallest subgraph_index PHYSICAL_REPLACEMENT candidate.
For physical-vs-physical, label the lower subgraph_index A and the higher B; for no-op-vs-physical, label NO_OP as A and PHYSICAL_REPLACEMENT as B.
LiteCut scores, STA, and structural hash differences are not used for pair selection.
